definitions.gloss: low price, bargain price, low value
definitions.explanation: A price that is low or cheap. Frequently used in financial and market contexts to describe stocks, commodities, or goods at a low price point. The opposite is {高値|たかね} (high price).

examples.japanese: {安値|やすね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}えた→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I was able to buy it at a low price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{年初来|ねんしょらい}{安値|やすね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: The stock price hit a new year-to-date low.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円|えん}{安|やす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}→輸入品：11505_yunyuuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{安値|やすね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}らなく→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the weak yen, imported goods are no longer available at low prices.

notes:
USAGE:
Especially common in financial reporting and market analysis. Often appears with superlative-like expressions: ⟦{最安値|さいやすね}→最安値：13443_saiyasune⟧ (lowest price), {年初来|ねんしょらい}{安値|やすね} (year-to-date low), ⟦{史上|しじょう}→史上：11806_shijou⟧⟦{最安値|さいやすね}→最安値：13443_saiyasune⟧ (all-time low).

SIMILAR WORDS:
The opposite is ⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧ (high price). For everyday shopping, ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ (cheap) is more common; {安値|やすね} has a more financial or market-oriented tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安値|やすね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at a low price
- {安値|やすね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧: to hit a new low
- ⟦{最安値|さいやすね}→最安値：13443_saiyasune⟧: lowest price, all-time low
- {年初来|ねんしょらい}{安値|やすね}: year-to-date low
- {安値|やすね}⟦{圏|けん}→圏：21183_ken⟧: low price range
